title: Quietly Juicy Indian Buns Kachori
description: A sweet and cozy Indian dish featuring buns filled with a juicy mixture, made with a mortar and pestle and FODMAP-friendly ingredients. This kachori is perfect for a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use a low FODMAP flour blend if necessary

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, ghee or oil, and salt, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the dates, almonds, and cardamom powder until well combined.
Add the sugar and water to the mortar and pestle and mix until a juicy mixture forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of the juicy mixture in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the kachori.
Heat the ghee or oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat and fry the kachori until golden brown.
Drain the kachori on paper towels and serve warm.
